text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that nostalgic sakura scent...!
Laurel-san, could that possibly be...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, there is no mistaking it—
it is none other than "Hanamaru Sakura Mochi"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Correct♪ We're having a class tea party,
so I borrowed the cafeteria kitchen to make some.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Hanamaru Sakura Mochi"—not found in my database.
What kind of confection is that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It is the famous sakura mochi specialty of "Victory Club"!
It is so wonderfully sweet, your cheeks will melt!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Still, making enough for the entire class
sure is a massive amount.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this a situation where you'd want to borrow even Chiyo's paw?
Laurel-san, please allow me to help!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Leave the batter preparation to me! Mixing shiratamako and water—
Bakushiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Pour batter in small amounts, keep the heat low!
A thickness of 2mm looks the most aesthetically pleasing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wrap the smooth red bean paste in the cooked batter,
and wrap the sakura leaf in a V-shape... All done♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status: "Astonishment"—such swift precision.
To think it could be manufactured with such high efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's because ever since we were little,
we always made "Hanamaru Sakura Mochi" together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Once a year, we'd hand them out to everyone who supported our club,
saying, "It was a perfect-score year," to show our gratitude—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And then we'd all eat a whole bunch
of sakura mochi together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So to prepare that huge amount,
everyone in the club worked together in harmony.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, even in confectionery production,
coordinating with others yields maximized performance.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! I really think making "Hanamaru Sakura Mochi"
taught me the true value of teamwork.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, allow me to become a unit of this team as well.
...Awaiting your orders, Laurel-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Production of "Hanamaru Sakura Mochi" complete.
However, this volume is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, what a mountainous quantity!
Mmm, truly a magnificent sight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came across Sakura Laurel and the others standing
in front of a literal mountain of sakura mochi on plates.
choice_data_list: What's with this mountain of sakura mochi...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Surprised? When all of us cooperated together,
we ended up making way too many!
choice_data_list: Just the four of you made this much?!
Just the four of you made this much?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes! Joining everyone's strength together
is truly incredible, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's not just simple addition—
when you multiply everyone's efforts, it turns into massive power!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, they just went a little overboard
with their teamwork this time...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now then! We've already set aside enough for the class tea party,
so what should we do with the rest?
choice_data_list: Why not just keep making even more?
Let's hand them out to the girls in the cafeteria.
Let's use teamwork to eat them all ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see. Since we're at it, having our entire grade
taste them sounds like a wonderful idea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Let us do precisely that!
With one more member added to our ranks,
our Bakushin-speed mass production is guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, before I knew it, I was roped into the team
and ended up helping make even more "Hanamaru Sakura Mochi."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That might be a brilliant idea! "Hanamaru Sakura Mochi"
goes wonderfully as a treat with tea, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They're sure to love it! After all,
it's the specialty of "Victory Club"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, it was a massive hit among the students in the cafeteria,
and requests for "Hanamaru Sakura Mochi" didn't stop for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Teamwork... You're right, if the five of us here
combine our strengths, nothing is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analysis results: if each individual consumes 31 pieces,
the surplus will be resolved.
Commencing mission.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, I joined in and savored
"Hanamaru Sakura Mochi" until my stomach was completely full.
